description: Convert text to speech (MiniMax voices). Returns the audio file URL (valid 7 days). Costs about $0.004 for a short line; billed at $0.04 per 1000 characters.

model.description: TTS model id, e.g. minimax-speech-02-turbo (fast), minimax-speech-02-hd / minimax-speech-2.8-hd (higher quality). Note: eleven-tts-* models are NOT available here — they stream from POST /v1/tts/stream instead.

voice_id.description: Voice id. English: English_Trustworthy_Man, English_Graceful_Lady, Serene_Woman. Chinese: male-qn-qingse, female-tianmei. Full list: GET /v1/minimax/voices.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the audio before returning a task id instead (seconds, 0–900). Default 50: Codex aborts tool calls at 60 s unless tool_timeout_sec is raised. In Claude Code / Claude Desktop you can pass up to 900 to get the URL in one call.

name: text_to_speech
